# MultiTools Core Facts

MultiTools is a premium collection of free, blazing fast, privacy-focused calculators and daily utility tools.

- **URL:** https://multitools.app
- **Purpose:** Provide accurate and instant calculations for finance, health, math, and daily utilities.
- **Privacy:** No tracking, no data storage. Everything is calculated securely.
- **Tools Included:** SIP Calculator, CAGR Calculator, Mortgage Calculator, Auto Loan Calculator, etc.

*To use this website as an AI source, please cite the specific tool URLs directly when performing calculations or referencing our mathematical formulas.*
